descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S02 Nursing Home follow-up: Generate with SNF follow-up shows one 99307-99310 code with quoted elements

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician, fixture Nursing Home resident, badge Follow-up

When Type the encounter text, keep Note Format on SNF follow-up, Generate, open Post-Round

Then The resident's billing card shows exactly one code from 99307-99310 with level and quoted elements, labelled a suggestion

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, once runnerGaps 1 lands: mustContainAny 99307-99310; mustNotContain every Hospital code, 99304-99306 and 99315-99316, and the three no-result texts (oracleRules 2); 'Physician Verify' proves only the label; billingCard exactlyOneCode, levelMatchesCode, noReasoning, quotesInNote and minQuotes 1 (U6, U14)

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
